tytul: ’Nduja: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for ’nduja, a spicy spreadable Calabrian sausage that is fermented, smoked and eaten without cooking. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to UGA, uncooked smoked sausages are smoked for flavor development and must be fully cooked before eating. [T:MIE-022]
According to UGA, a sausage is shelf stable only when its water activity is below 0.85 and its pH is under 5.3. [T:MIE-023]
Without an effective starter culture, fermentation temperatures of 80–100 °F can let dangerous bacteria grow in the meat. [T:MIE-025]

akapity: ’Nduja is eaten without cooking, so it does not meet this UGA rule. [T:MIE-022]
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for ’nduja from a checked source. [T:-]
